_how_to_read: Every data source, shown on the /sources page and in the README Data table. status: real | simulated | estimated. use: replay (played on screen), test (checks our code), thresholds (sets status limits), reference (shown or cited, not judged). 'TO FILL IN' marks a value a team member still has to add. Keep in step with docs/resources.md. used_for_review: who still has to confirm the 'used for' text.

sources.title: Solar particle event (NASA DONKI)
sources.badge: Timing from real NASA DONKI event 2024-05-10T13:35:00-SEP-001; dose simulated
sources.provider: NASA Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information (DONKI), via the CCMC
sources.what: Real solar energetic particle event 2024-05-10T13:35:00-SEP-001 (May 2024 solar storm), seen by GOES-P SEISS >10 MeV, with its 14 linked flares and CMEs. Taken from the saved file of 14 SEP events (May 1 to 31, 2024). Event id, time and link are real; the dose curve is simulated ("dose simulated; timing from real DONKI event"). The replay runs at every location; the same curve is multiplied by a DRAFT factor per location: ISS 1x, Mars surface 3x, Moon base and Moon rover 5x, Mars transit 10x.
used_for: 'Replay solar event' demo control (/admin)
Solar event alert and 'go to shelter' advice
Radiation region turns Act now during the event
sources.units: mSv/h (simulated dose rate), mSv (dose from the event)
sources.name: NASA DONKI: solar particle event
sources.status_note: Event id, time and link are real; the dose curve during the event is simulated.

sources.title: Real crew blood values (Inspiration4)
sources.badge: Real crew reference: NASA OSDR OSD-575, Inspiration4 (4 civilian crew, 3-day flight)
sources.provider: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR), study OSD-575 (SpaceX Inspiration4)
sources.what: Serum comprehensive metabolic panel of the 4 civilian Inspiration4 crew (3-day flight, 2021) at 7 timepoints, 92 days before launch to 194 days after return. We show glucose, sodium and potassium as they are in the file, with the file's units and the lab's reference range: the last test before flight (L-3) and the first after (R+1). Reference only: no status colours and no interpretation. Glucose is converted only to follow the mmol/L / mg/dL toggle.
used_for: Daily check glucose step: 'Real crew reference' line
Metabolism region: 'Real crew reference' line and a Learn-tab table (glucose, sodium, potassium)
sources.units: Glucose mg/dL, sodium and potassium mmol/L (as in the file)
sources.name: NASA OSDR OSD-575: Inspiration4 blood panel

sources.title: Reaction test reference group (CSA PRET)
sources.badge: Compared with 145 people tested for the Canadian Space Agency (PRET, ground study; lapse >= 355 ms)
sources.provider: Canadian Space Agency open data: Performance Readiness Evaluation and Training Tool (PRET), version 4.0
sources.what: Psychomotor Vigilance Test raw data from the PRET Phase 3 ground study (Carleton University for the CSA): 159 people, one 10-minute session each (2-10 s gaps, counter up to 500 ms). We recomputed each person's median reaction time of hits and lapse rate (lapse = 355 ms or slower) with our own rules, left out 14 sessions (false starts over 10 %, misses over 20 %, or task misunderstanding), and use the other 145: median RT 50th / 90th / 97.5th percentile 264 / 318.4 / 345.8 ms, lapse rate 8.43 / 30.16 / 47.49 %. Ground study, not astronauts; their test was 10 minutes, ours is 3.
used_for: Reaction test result: 'faster than Y% of the CSA reference group'
Brain and mood region: Watch above the 90th percentile, Warning above the 97.5th (DRAFT, Yenna reviews)
Personas A and B reaction-test values
sources.name: CSA PRET: reaction test reference group

sources.title: PhysioNet BIDMC PPG and Respiration
sources.badge: PhysioNet BIDMC (Earth recordings, used to test our PPG code)
sources.what: Real fingertip PPG with reference ECG and breathing signals, recorded from hospital patients on Earth. Jian uses it to test our PPG code (heart rate, breathing rate) against the reference signals. Not shown on screen.
used_for: Testing compute_vitals(): heart rate and breathing rate from PPG

validation.label: Validation result (Jian)
validation.value: All 53 records (re-run Nov 15, docs/validation/bidmc_all53_summary.json): median per-record pulse-rate error 0.86 bpm, pooled MAE 2.59 bpm, 91.9% of seconds within ±5 bpm, a value in 97.2% of seconds. 4 records over 5 bpm MAE (bidmc_18, 40, 41, 45). Pulse rate only; breathing rate is not computed from PPG.

sources.name: PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2015 (false ICU alarms)
sources.title: PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2015
sources.badge: PhysioNet Challenge 2015 (Earth recordings, used to test alarms)
sources.what: Real bedside recordings (ECG, PPG, blood pressure) around ICU arrhythmia alarms, each marked true or false. Jian uses it to test our irregular-rhythm and lost-pulse alarms. Not shown on screen.
used_for: Testing the irregular rhythm flag and the lost-pulse alarm

validation.label: Validation result (Jian)
validation.value: Asystole alarms (122; 17 true and 89 false with a PPG channel, docs/ppg-review.md): no lost-pulse detector to score. At the alarm second the pipeline never reported 'no beats': true asystole showed a pulse rate in 6/17 and poor signal in 10/17. So Measurement mode raises no alerts.
